title: God Rebuilds the Burnt-Out Life
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner draws a poignant parallel between the devastating effects of wildfires and the destructive forces of our past, but also the redemptive power of God to restore and rebuild. If you've been left feeling like your life is nothing but ashes and ashes of heartache, this sermon is for you. Join Pastor Chris as he shares a message of hope and renewal, reminding us that no matter what we've been through, God can take our shattered lives and rebuild them into something beautiful.
